content: Hi how can i assist you today
Rain on the window taps out patterns after I form questions. It sounds like Morse.
Raindrop rhythms vary with wind and pane angle. Do you hear the effect more on gusty days or steady rain?
Gusts create clusters that can feel message-like. On still days, does the tapping feel less like code?
Uniform tapping is typical in steady conditions. If you record a minute in both cases, the contrast in spacing usually stands out.
I can capture a clip next storm.
Side-by-side clips tend to highlight the role of wind rather than intent.
I’ll compare them when I have both.
